text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for inviting me to your 
tea party the other day, Ramonu-senpai."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, my. Thank you for being so polite.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The autumnal Darjeeling tea you gave me 
that day was truly exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The thoughtful gift I received— the 
pudding à la mode— had such an uplifting, 
revitalizing flavor.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Most of all, it was truly wonderful. My 
parents were also overjoyed by the Mejiro 
family's generous hospitality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I believe I've met your parents before. On 
the cruise ship around New Year's—?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
This must be fate as well. Please give 
them my warmest regards.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, that reminds me. Next time, please 
allow me to be the one to host everyone!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'd really love for you to try our gibier 
hot pot, made with abundant blessings from 
the mountains and fields.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I've also identified the habitat where 
delicious wild herbs grow. Early spring is 
especially recommended, so... I will send 
you another formal invitation then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Heh... When I'm talking with you, I 
forget. About that peculiar color, I mean.
